snippet.title: Go Ahead - Official gameplay teaser
snippet.description:
A third-person action game that challenges your reflexes and reasoning with deadly traps, puzzles, and precision. Overcome extreme laboratory challenges and discover what awaits you beyond the next step.

Demo available now on steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3874300/Go_Ahead/
